metadata.title: feat: add experimental Rust LLM gateway runtime
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary
- add an experimental Rust LLM gateway sidecar following the modular runtime boundary introduced by #3617
- delegate supported `/v1/models`, `/v1/chat/completions`, and gateway-backed `llmchat` session traffic through Rust behind feature flags
- keep Python authoritative for auth/RBAC and model-provider resolution through a trusted internal SPI
- add runtime health/readiness reporting, container wiring, and nginx resolver-based upstream proxying for recreated gateway containers

## Implementation
- add the `tools_rust/llm_gateway` crate for provider relay, streaming normalization, and sidecar health endpoints
- add internal Python-to-Rust gateway plumbing in `internal_llm_gateway_router.py` and `rust_llm_gateway_proxy.py`
- route only supported providers to Rust with Python fallback for unsupported runtimes
- report the active LLM runtime from `/health` and `/ready`
- ignore generated Pact artifacts and prune nested Rust `target/` outputs from packaging

## Validation
- `make test`
- `UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache make ruff`
- `make pylint`
- `make flake8`
- `make bandit`
- `CARGO_HOME=/tmp/cargo-home make rust-check`
- `make verify`
- focused pytest coverage for the Rust gateway router, proxy, LLM proxy routing, `llmchat`, config, and health/readiness paths
- live docker/nginx smoke with Rust mode enabled for `/health`, `/ready`, and authenticated `/v1/models`
